title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Biot's Model via Fixed-Stress Splitting and Energy Natural Gradient Descent
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have recently gained considerable attention as a mesh-free framework for solving partial differential equations. Nevertheless, their performance deteriorates when applied to strongly coupled multiphysics systems, such as Biot's consolidation model, due to severely ill-conditioned optimization landscapes. In this work, we propose a robust PINN-based solver, termed FS-ENGD-PINN, which synergistically integrates physics-based decoupling with geometry-aware optimization.
